{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Soup Ladle Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Soup Ladle Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Soup Ladle Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Soup Ladle Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 4 |TotK= 4 }} |durability= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 5 |TotK= 5 }} |comp= |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Soup Ladle|Soup Ladles|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 4 |durability = 5 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Soup Ladle}} Soup Ladles are a wooden kitchen implement used for serving soup. They can be found in [[Hyrule Field]] and on the [[Tabantha Frontier]]. One in particular can be found by the [[Cooking Pot]] in the [[Shared Cooking Space]] of [[Hateno Village]]. As they are made from the wood of sturdy [[Tree]]s, [[Link]] can use Soup Ladles to inflict a low amount of damage to [[Enemy|Enemies]]. Due to their wooden composition, Soup Ladles will burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, and they do not conduct [[Electricity]]. If they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], they will float on its surface. Soup Ladles belong to the [[Daily Use Goods]] equipment archetype, which consists of [[Weapon]]s that double as tools used in the daily lives of [[Hyrule Kingdom|Hyrule]] residents. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_022" |Life = 5 |Power = 4 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 1 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 2 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 45 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 5 |BuyingPrice = 20 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = One-Handed Weapon |strength = 4 |durability = 5 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Soup Ladle}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link One-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} The Soup Ladle is an [[Item]] that serves as a relatively weak [[Weapon]], accompanied by a [[Pot Lid]] and a [[Wooden Bow]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where the Item is found * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} Soup Ladles are [[One-Handed Weapon]]s in {{AoI}}. As a result, they can be wielded by the [[Knight Construct]], [[Typhan]], [[Lago]], [[Vence]], and [[Sholani]].
